infobox.usage: Unlocks Sanitar's room on the second level of The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Keycard with a blue marking (Keycard) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A single-use plastic keycard with a blue color marking, probably for identification. The logo covered by the marking resembles the TerraGroup Labs logo.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Used in Therapist's quest TerraGroup Employee
- Used in Therapist's quest Health Care Privacy - Part 6

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
The door just in front of the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level in The Lab.

Location marked on map

The door

sections.heading: Behind the lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Meds and Medical supplies)
- 1x Jacket
- Ophthalmoscope spawns
- Stimulants

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The serial number on the back side is "0212306726261241".
